metadata.title: AHMEDABAD Street Food Tour | Part - 1/4 | Gujarat Food Tour I India Food Tour
metadata.description:
Ahmedabad, a city located on the banks of Sabarmati river in Gujarat. Also known as Amdavad, the city has emerged as an important economic and industrial hub in India. 

Delhi Food Walks went on a food tour exploring the rich food heritage of the city.  The journey started with first visiting the Sabarmati Ashram. A national monument with great historical significance attached to it, the father of Indian nation, Mahatma Gandhi lived here for about twelve years along with his wife Kasturba Gandhi.

Coming to street food, Gujrat is the land of innovation and creativity. The variety of street food one get to taste in whole of Gujrat is incomparable. As most of the population is vegetarian, the street dishes are predominantly vegetarian. 

Make sure to watch Ahmedabad food journey till end to enjoy the food ride with Delhi Food Walks.

About the host- Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
